steps.message: What was the total duration of mountain biking activities in the OpenTracks app this week? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer in minutes as a single integer.

Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -i opentracks; ls -d /data/user/0/*opentracks* /data/data/*opentracks* 2>/dev/null; ls /data/user/0/de.dennisguse.opentracks/databases 2>/dev/null; ls /data/data/de.dennisguse.opentracks/databases 2>/dev/null"
